description:
Split from fz-mue.7 (user approved 2026-11-20, relayed by Optimize; page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.7.html, Decision 2).

json.erl's encoder sorts a map's keys through maps:to_list(maps:iterator(Map, ordered)) (json.erl:671). iterator(M, ordered) is [lists:sort(fun cmp_term/2 =< 0, maps:keys(M)) | M] and next on a key-list path looks each key up.

- :lists.sort/2: OTP's merge sort with a compare fun (lists.erl:1882 and the fsplit/rmerge family), ported faithfully.
- :erts_internal.cmp_term/2: one extern over the existing term-order comparator (map key order is term order on stored words, fz-sc8.192.6).
- iterator/2 and map_next on a key-list path.
- BEAM per entry for to_list(iterator(M, ordered)): 1,092 at 40 keys, 3,121 at 100,000. Predictions on this ticket's page, page first.

After the improper iterator (blocked by the .7b ticket). Owner: Optimize.
title: :maps.iterator(M, ordered) walks keys in term order, through :lists.sort/2 and :erts_internal.cmp_term/2
